summary: Exodus Movement, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting its acquisition of Monavate Holdings Limited and Baanx.com Ltd shares from receivers for $76.3M, satisfied by netting off outstanding loans. The company also entered a Stock and Asset Purchase Agreement for Baanx US Corp. and related assets for $30M, payable in installments over four years. The transactions follow a dispute and lawsuit over a prior stock purchase agreement with W3C Corp. and Garth Howat. No board recommendation or advisors named. The acquisitions expand Exodus' fintech/crypto payment capabilities. Watch for litigation resolution and integration execution.
